brief:
Israeli occupation forces conducted a renewed incursion into al-Maghier village, located north of Ramallah, according to Shehab Wire. The operation represents another military entry into the Palestinian community in the central West Bank region.

Details about the scope, duration, and stated objectives of the raid remained unclear at the time of reporting. Israeli forces have conducted multiple operations in areas north of Ramallah in recent months as part of broader military activity across the occupied West Bank.
